properties.description: This modern four-bedroom semi-detached house offers a perfect blend of style and functionality. The property boasts off-street parking and a large south-facing private garden, complete with a bright studio room. The main bedroom features an en-suite and a walk-in wardrobe, adding a touch of luxury. The contemporary and spacious kitchen is ideal for family living, while the bright and airy reception room enhances the home’s inviting atmosphere. Conveniently located within walking distance of Petts Wood Station, the property is also in the catchment area for Crofton Infant School and just minutes from a variety of shops, restaurants, and bars.
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description:
Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this three double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms.
This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee...

This delightful three-bedroom house offers modern and versatile living, ideal for families or first-time buyers. The property features a master bedroom with an en-suite, two additional bedrooms, and a well-appointed family bathroom. The spacious sitting room and open-plan kitchen/dining area provide excellent spaces for relaxation and entertaining. Outside, the enclosed rear gardens offer a private outdoor retreat. The property also benefits from a garage and parking. Available with no onward chain, this home is ready for immediate occupancy.
properties.location: 37, Collingwood Fields, East Bergholt, Colchester, Suffolk CO7 6QN

properties.description: This charming three-bedroom flat offers a comfortable and practical living space, ideal for families. The property features a lounge and dining room, providing ample room for relaxation and entertaining. An attractive rear garden adds to its appeal, perfect for outdoor enjoyment. Additionally, the property includes a garage and a designated parking space. Situated in a popular village location, it combines a peaceful setting with easy access to local amenities.
properties.location: 76, Broom Knoll, East Bergholt, Colchester, Suffolk CO7 6XN

properties.description: This spacious two-bedroom ground floor apartment spans two floors, offering a unique and practical layout. It features two generously sized double bedrooms and a private garden, perfect for outdoor relaxation. With excellent transport links nearby, the property ensures convenient connectivity. Available with no onward chain, this home is ideal for those seeking a ready-to-move-in opportunity.

This substantial residence is situated directly on Shoreham Beach, with captivating views to the south over the beach and out to sea. The detached property was originally constructed as a bungalow and then converted and re designed by a respected local architect to create a contemporary home with lots of glazing and high ceilings – flooding the home with natural light. On the south side of the house there’s a fabulous balcony, which is perfect for entertaining with views of the sea, which opens up to the reception rooms to make a big entertaining space.

This well-maintained detached chalet bungalow offers comfortable and versatile living with four spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms. The property features a garage and convenient off-street parking, along with beautifully kept front and rear gardens, perfect for outdoor relaxation. Situated just a short walk from Feltham Mainline Station and Feltham High Street, it combines peaceful living with easy access to local amenities and excellent transport links.
properties.location: Glencoe, Ashfield Avenue, Feltham, Greater London TW13 5BB

properties.description: This single-storey property, under the same ownership since 1986, offers a desirable blend of comfort and charm in a prime location. It features three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a shower room, and a large reception area. The Baultaup-designed kitchen enhances the modern appeal, while the private front garden and courtyard patio provide excellent outdoor spaces. Situated in a highly sought-after area, this property embodies timeless appeal and convenience.
properties.location: Hall Road, St John's Wood, London NW8 9RD
